title: Ricardo Gill — Consciousness and continuity research
author: Ricardo Gill
research_status: Exploratory hypothesis evaluation; no validated continuity or sentience test

finder_profile.audience: Consciousness and continuity research researchers, developers and evaluators
finder_profile.required_capability: Read original sources, design controlled tests, retain provenance and distinguish proposals from findings.

possible_application: Specify competing explanations, architecture-level predictions and ethically governed tests. Separate behavioural similarity, preserved information and first-person continuity. Use adversarial collaboration rather than training a model to assert consciousness.
illustrative_example: A system reproduces remembered statements. Compare information-copying explanations with the stronger continuity claim and identify what evidence could distinguish them.
evaluation_targets: Discriminating predictions, explicit confounds, reproducibility, theory-specific evidence and reported negative findings.
requested_contribution: Read, test, adapt or critique the authored research; report methods, source version, comparisons, results and limitations.
source_relation: Related sources establish background problems or methods, not independent validation or endorsement of GCI.
